articles.title_en: Late-career unemployment shocks, pension outcomes and unemployment insurance
articles.title_cn: 职业生涯晚期的失业冲击、养老金结果与失业保险
articles.abstract_en: In response to unemployment shocks, older workers deplete their 401(k)s, particularly after the waiving of the early withdrawal penalty on unemployment-motivated withdrawals at age 55. This paper shows that unemployment insurance keeps older workers from depleting their 401(k) assets following job losses. Unemployment insurance also incentivizes older unemployed workers to delay claiming their Social Security benefits beyond the earliest age of eligibility, 62. Overall, unemployment insurance enhances the retirement income of the individuals having a history of late-career layoffs by helping them preserve their 401(k) assets, maintain the return on these assets and opt for a higher stream of Social Security benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 面对失业冲击，老年工人会耗尽他们的401(k)账户，特别是在55岁时免除因失业动机提取的提前取款罚金之后。本文表明，失业保险能防止老年工人在失业后耗尽401(k)资产。失业保险还激励老年失业工人将社会保障福利的申领推迟到最早资格年龄62岁之后。总体而言，失业保险通过帮助有晚期失业历史的个人保留401(k)资产、维持这些资产的回报并选择更高的社会保障福利流，从而提高了他们的退休收入。

articles.title_en: The $100 million nudge: Increasing tax compliance of firms using a natural field experiment
articles.title_cn: 100 百万美元的推动：利用自然实地实验提高公司的税收合规性
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses a natural field experiment to examine the effectiveness of deterrence messages on tax compliance in the Dominican Republic. In collaboration with the tax authority, we sent messages to 56,310 firms that collectively paid $700 million in the year before the experiment. Our field experiment complements a tax enforcement reform in the Dominican Republic a year before our intervention. Sharing information about prison sentences or the public disclosure of evasion arising from the tax enforcement reform increases tax revenue by $184 million (0.22% of GDP). Using a unique sample that covers the entire firm size distribution, we show that the largest firms, that pay 84% of all corporate income taxes and typically have been excluded from this type of intervention, are highly responsive to our information treatments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用自然现场实验来检验威慑信息对多米尼加共和国税收合规性的有效性。我们与税务机关合作，向 56,310 公司发送了消息，这些公司在实验前一年总共支付了 700 百万美元。我们的实地实验补充了我们干预前一年多米尼加共和国的税务执法改革。分享有关监禁刑期或公开披露税收执法改革引起的逃税行为的信息可增加税收收入184百万美元（占GDP的0.22%。使用涵盖整个企业规模分布的独特样本，我们表明，支付84%所有企业所得税且通常被排除在此类干预之外的最大企业对我们的信息处理高度敏感。

articles.title_en: Overclaimed refunds, undeclared sales, and invoice mills: Nature and extent of noncompliance in a value-added tax
articles.title_cn: 过度申报退税、未申报销售与发票工厂：增值税不遵从的性质与程度
articles.abstract_en: Value-added tax has seen phenomenal expansion in recent decades. Its appeal in part lies in its robustness to tax evasion relative to other tax instruments. Exploiting a tax reform from Pakistan that cuts the tax rate on five major industries of the country substantially, I estimate the size and nature of VAT evasion in the treated industries, finding that it ranges from 31–46% of the potential revenue. One important channel through which the evasion occurs is the overclaim of refunds, which constitute 11–23% of the potential revenue. Roughly two-fifths of the overclaimed refund is based on spurious invoices issued by invoice mills. Qualitatively, noncompliance is stronger in the latter stages of the supply chain, but it runs deep inside the chain, suggesting that on their own the self-enforcement mechanisms built into a VAT do not deter tax evasion fully.
articles.abstract_cn: 增值税在近几十年经历了显著扩张。其吸引力部分在于相对于其他税收工具，它对逃税的稳健性。利用巴基斯坦的一项税制改革，该改革大幅降低了该国五个主要行业的税率，我估计了受处理行业中增值税逃税的规模与性质，发现其占潜在收入的31-46%。逃税发生的一个重要渠道是过度申报退税，这占潜在收入的11-23%。大约五分之二的过度申报退税基于发票工厂开具的虚假发票。从性质上看，不遵从在供应链的后端更为严重，但深入供应链内部，这表明增值税内置的自我执行机制本身并不能完全阻止逃税。

articles.title_en: The returns to an additional year of education for college graduates
articles.title_cn: 大学毕业生额外一年教育的回报
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the returns to an additional year of advanced undergraduate education among students who would otherwise graduate with a bachelor’s degree using administrative student records merged with survey data on earnings from the largest public university in Singapore. We use a regression discontinuity design that exploits the fact that in some faculties, enrollment in the fourth (honors) year is governed by a grade-based eligibility rule. Students with average grades in their third year just above the threshold are significantly more likely to complete the fourth year and have higher earnings after graduation relative to students who narrowly missed the grade cutoff. The implied earnings return to the additional year of college is about 12 % six months after graduation. Linked administrative tax data confirm persistent gains in the longer run for at least 4 years after graduation. Moreover, the return remains substantial even after the university lowers the threshold to encourage more students to enroll in the fourth year, suggesting an effect not entirely driven by signaling of student ability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用新加坡最大公立大学的行政学生记录与收入调查数据相结合，估计了那些原本将获得学士学位的学生额外接受一年高级本科教育的回报。我们采用断点回归设计，利用在某些学院，第四年（荣誉）入学受基于成绩的资格规则约束这一事实。第三年平均成绩刚好超过门槛的学生，完成第四年的可能性显著更高，并且毕业后收入高于那些勉强未达到成绩截止线的学生。额外一年大学教育所隐含的收入回报在毕业后六个月约为12%。关联的行政税务数据证实，毕业后至少4年内，长期收益持续存在。此外，即使大学降低门槛以鼓励更多学生进入第四年，回报仍然可观，这表明效应并非完全由学生能力的信号传递所驱动。

articles.title_en: Measuring corruption in the field using behavioral games
articles.title_cn: 使用行为博弈在实地测量腐败
articles.abstract_en: Corruption is often harmful for economic development, yet it is difficult to measure due to its illicit nature. We propose a novel corruption game to characterize the interaction between actual political leaders and citizens, and implement it in Northern Mozambique. Contrary to the game-theoretic prediction, both leaders and citizens engage in corruption. Importantly, corruption in the game is correlated with real-world corruption by leaders: citizens send bribes to leaders whom we observe appropriating community money. In corrupt behavior, we identify an important trust dimension captured by a standard trust game.
articles.abstract_cn: 腐败常常对经济发展有害，但由于其非法性质，难以测量。我们提出了一种新颖的腐败博弈来刻画实际政治领导人与公民之间的互动，并在莫桑比克北部实施。与博弈论预测相反，领导人和公民都参与了腐败。重要的是，博弈中的腐败与领导人在现实世界中的腐败相关：公民向那些我们观察到挪用社区资金的领导人行贿。在腐败行为中，我们识别出一个由标准信任博弈捕捉的重要信任维度。

articles.title_en: Do elections affect immigration? Evidence from French municipalities
articles.title_cn: 选举是否影响移民？来自法国市镇的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using thirty years of municipal elections in France, we show that election results affect the share of immigrants across municipalities. In municipalities where a left- instead of right-wing mayor has been elected, the share of immigrants in the population grows faster by 1.5 p.p. within six years after the elections, and by 3 p.p. within twelve years. To a large extent, these effects are driven by partisan differences in public housing constructions and changes in the composition of the population within existing public housing units. They also are associated with greater incumbency advantage, in line with a model of strategic partisan behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用法国三十年的市政选举数据，我们表明选举结果影响各市镇移民的比例。在选举出左翼而非右翼市长的市镇中，选举后六年内移民人口比例增长更快，高出1.5个百分点，十二年内高出3个百分点。在很大程度上，这些效应是由公共住房建设中的党派差异以及现有公共住房单元内人口构成的变化所驱动的。它们还与更大的在位优势相关，这与战略性党派行为模型一致。

articles.title_en: Lost boys? Secondary education and crime
articles.title_cn: 迷失的男孩？中等教育与犯罪
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of secondary education on criminal behavior of young men in Finland. We exploit admission cut-offs in over-subscribed programs and estimate the effect of gaining access to a) any secondary school vs no access, b) general vs vocational school, and c) selective vs less selective general school. Our results show that admission to any secondary school has a sizeable negative effect on the propensity to commit crime. There are no effects at the other two margins. The negative effects at the extensive margin are largest in the years following school admission and result in a reduction of the probability of ever committing crime rather than simply delaying the onset of crime. Our results suggest that keeping youth at school at a critical age has effects that last beyond years where effects on enrollment are observed.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中等教育对芬兰年轻男性犯罪行为的影响。我们利用超额报名项目中的录取分数线，估计了获得以下机会的效果：a) 进入任何中等学校与无法进入，b) 普通学校与职业学校，以及 c) 选择性普通学校与选择性较低的普通学校。我们的结果表明，进入任何中等学校对犯罪倾向有显著的负向影响。在其他两个边际上没有影响。广泛边际上的负向影响在入学后的几年中最大，并导致犯罪概率的降低，而不仅仅是延迟犯罪的发生。我们的结果表明，在关键年龄让青少年留在学校，其影响持续到观察到入学效应之后的年份。

articles.title_en: Nonlinear taxation and international mobility in general equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 一般均衡中的非线性税收与国际流动性
articles.abstract_en: Migration and general equilibrium forces are both known to limit the extent of redistribution due to a migration threat and a trickle-down rationale, respectively. In this paper, we consider these two forces jointly and study the optimal nonlinear taxation of internationally mobile workers in general equilibrium. We show that both forces partly offset each other. In general equilibrium, migration may lower the bottom tax rate but raises the top tax rate, challenging the classical migration-threat argument. Moreover, we demonstrate that migration responses weaken the trickle-down rationale. Both findings can be explained by a novel wage effect on migration and a migration effect on wages, calling for higher top tax rates to amplify pre-tax wage inequality and prevent high-skilled emigration. We calibrate our model to the U.S. economy and illustrate the new effects by comparing the optimal tax schemes with and without migration, as well as with and without endogeneity of wages.
articles.abstract_cn: 迁移和一般均衡力量均已知分别通过迁移威胁和涓滴效应限制再分配的程度。在本文中，我们共同考虑这两种力量，并研究一般均衡中国际流动工人的最优非线性税收。我们表明，这两种力量部分相互抵消。在一般均衡中，迁移可能降低底部税率但提高顶部税率，挑战了经典的迁移威胁论点。此外，我们证明迁移反应削弱了涓滴效应。这两个发现都可以通过迁移对工资的新效应和工资对迁移的效应来解释，这要求更高的顶部税率以扩大税前工资不平等并防止高技能移民。我们将模型校准到美国经济，并通过比较有迁移和无迁移、以及工资内生和工资外生的最优税收方案来说明新效应。

articles.title_en: Provider turf wars and Medicare payment rules
articles.title_cn: 提供者地盘之争与医疗保险支付规则
articles.abstract_en: Barriers to entry and scope of work restrictions are common features of US labor markets, especially within healthcare industries. However, concerns over access and costs of care have encouraged some deregulation. We empirically explore relaxed occupational rules of anesthesia care whereby physician-trained anesthesiologists and certified registered nurse anesthetists (CRNAs) perform overlapping services but often engage in joint production. After CRNAs were granted practice independence, we find only modest (3%) reductions in anesthesiologist billing for CRNA supervision and no evidence of greater use of CRNAs. Our results caution policymakers against overestimating the downstream impact resulting from removing these provider regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 进入壁垒和工作范围限制是美国劳动力市场的常见特征，尤其是在医疗保健行业。然而，对护理获取和成本的担忧促使了一些放松管制。我们实证探讨了麻醉护理中放宽的职业规则，即由医师培训的麻醉师和认证注册护士麻醉师（CRNAs）执行重叠服务，但往往进行联合生产。在CRNAs获得执业独立性后，我们发现麻醉师对CRNA监督的计费仅适度（3%）减少，且没有证据表明CRNAs的使用增加。我们的结果提醒政策制定者不要高估取消这些提供者法规所带来的下游影响。

articles.title_en: Taxation, accountability, and cash transfers: Breaking the resource curse
articles.title_cn: 税收、问责与现金转移：打破资源诅咒
articles.abstract_en: Why is governance in resource-rich countries so poor? We argue that it is because governments in these countries do not rely on taxation, which is an important instrument for citizens to hold their governments accountable. Using a game-theoretic model, we show that the combination of low taxes and weak governance can be an equilibrium in an economy with sizeable mineral revenues. As income from natural resources ultimately declines, replacing it with tax revenues may require governments to give control of these proceeds to citizens, in the form of cash transfers say, as a credible commitment to accountability, thereby breaking the country out of its resource curse.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么资源丰富国家的治理如此糟糕？我们认为，这是因为这些国家的政府不依赖税收，而税收是公民问责政府的重要工具。通过博弈论模型，我们表明，在拥有可观矿产收入的经济体中，低税收和弱治理的组合可以成为一种均衡。随着自然资源收入最终下降，用税收收入替代它可能需要政府以现金转移等形式将这些收入的控制权交给公民，作为对问责的可信承诺，从而使国家摆脱资源诅咒。

articles.title_en: Organizational design for making a difference
articles.title_cn: 为创造差异而进行的组织设计
articles.abstract_en: We address organizations that rely on donors, when those donors are motivated by making a difference. We show that when donors care sufficiently about their marginal impact, firms use practices that would normally be deemed inefficient. These include prioritizing less valuable opportunities over better ones, investing most in their weakest initiatives, and benefiting from not identifying the quality of their projects. These all arise from a distinction between marginal and average returns generated by donor preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究依赖捐赠者的组织，当这些捐赠者受到创造差异的动机驱动时。我们表明，当捐赠者足够关心他们的边际影响时，企业会采用通常被认为低效的做法。这些做法包括优先考虑价值较低的机会而非更好的机会，将最多的投资用于最弱的项目，以及从不识别其项目质量中获益。所有这些都源于捐赠者偏好所产生的边际回报与平均回报之间的区别。
